title: How many times does the loop filter play?
fullTitle: FFmpeg loop Filter: loop=2 Plays 3 Times, start=10 Begins at Frame 9

scenes.narration: The loop filter repeats frames. Is size in frames or seconds? Does loop equals two play the frames twice, or three times? A fifty frame counter clip, every frame holds its own number. On f f m peg six point one point one.
captions: loop: frames or seconds? Two plays or three?
A 50 frame counter clip. Every frame names itself.

scenes.narration: Loop equals two, size equals five, start equals ten. Fifty frames in, sixty out. The five frames play three times, not two: loop counts extra plays. Loop one adds five frames, two adds ten, three adds fifteen.
captions: N extra plays add 5 x N frames.

scenes.narration: Size is frames. Same filter at ten, twenty five and fifty frames a second: the same five frames repeat. The extra time is half a second, a fifth, a tenth. And size is a maximum: size one hundred repeats only forty one frames.
captions: size is frames: 5 frames at 10, 25, 50 fps.
size 100 repeats only the 41 frames left.

scenes.narration: Start. Start equals ten repeats frame nine, not ten. Start counts from one: start zero and start one are the same loop, from frame zero. Two readers agree on all eighty cases.
captions: start 0 and 1: the same loop, from frame 0.

scenes.narration: Time has no off by one: zero point four seconds at twenty five frames a second starts at frame ten. But start defaults to zero, so time alone loops from frame zero. Set start to minus one. Size zero, the default, loops nothing.
captions: time=0.4 starts at frame 10, if start=-1.
Default size 0 loops nothing: 50 frames out.

scenes.narration: Loop equals minus one never ends. With dash frames colon v one hundred twenty, you get one hundred twenty frames: zero to thirteen, then nine to thirteen again. Unguarded, it was still running when killed at three seconds.
captions: Unguarded: killed after 3 s, never ended.

scenes.narration: To loop frames ten to fourteen on six point one point one, write start equals eleven. Loop counts extra plays, size counts frames. Guard minus one. Not tested: eight point one point two, audio loops, real footage.
